purpose: Screen distinct perpetual-futures information sets without reading project candidate returns or reopening sealed trials.

sources_reviewed.title: Point-in-Time Audit Before Alpha: Public-Archive Availability and a Negative Matched-Budget Study on BTC Perpetual Futures
sources_reviewed.finding_used: The paper treats historical open interest as unavailable for factor admission because its archive publication time is unverified; it also reports that positive historical IC did not survive its preregistered fee-and-slippage economic tests.

sources_reviewed.title: Volume Profile Mean Reversion Strategy with Tape Speed Confirmation for Cryptocurrency Futures Markets
sources_reviewed.finding_used: The accessible abstract proposes previous-day volume-profile levels and a tape-speed confirmation, but the primary PDF could not be retrieved during screening and the accessible record does not specify a complete reproducible signal, timing, universe, or execution contract.

candidates.name: HISTORICAL_OPEN_INTEREST_CROWDING
candidates.reason: Historical Binance open-interest archives lack demonstrated publication or receive time. Using their event timestamp as a decision-time feature would leave an unresolved future-information path. The closely related Alpha 010 is already sealed FAIL on its preregistered rule and may not be retuned.
candidates.policy_action: research/historical-research-policy.json now blocks historical OI as a decision feature until source-specific availability evidence is supplied.
candidates.permitted_follow_up: Only a new forward hypothesis may use OI after append-only capture with a local UTC receive time, source endpoint, and preregistered decision delay.

candidates.name: VOLUME_PROFILE_TAPE_SPEED_MEAN_REVERSION
candidates.reason: The accessible study description is not enough to fix all signal definitions, session boundary treatment, confirmation computation, trading universe, order role, and cost assumptions before project returns are seen. A follow-up search found no public code repository or complete alternative method specification. It also needs an independence review against sealed Alpha 002 before any trial could be numbered.

queries: Volume Profile Mean Reversion Strategy Tape Speed GitHub
follow_up_reproducibility_search.primary_source_access: SSRN full PDF download was unavailable to the research browser during both attempts.

required_before_any_preregistration: primary-source method or supplement containing every signal and execution rule
preregistered fee, funding, spread, slippage, and fill model

selected_next_step: NO_NEW_EXPERIMENT; preserve the OI availability block and continue existing forward public-data collection.
